email.subject: POAP KINGS is recruiting — a Clash Royale clan worth staying in
email.body:
Most clans are just a list of names. POAP KINGS is something different.

We are an active Clash Royale clan built around Clan Wars, real recognition, and a culture that remembers its members. Our top players are pushing past 13,000 trophies. We donate close to 4,000 cards a week. And we have traditions most clans do not — including POAPs, a Free Pass Royale program for top war contributors, and an AI system called Elixir that tracks milestones and keeps the clan's memory alive.

We were founded by three people who wanted to build something worth being part of. That is still the goal.

If you are active, war-minded, and looking for a clan with structure behind it, we want to hear from you. Minimum 3,000 trophies to join.

Learn more and apply at https://poapkings.com

reddit.title: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG) — War-focused clan recruiting active players [3000]
reddit.body:
**POAP KINGS** is recruiting. We are an active, war-focused Clash Royale clan with real structure behind it — not just a Discord and a clan tag.

**Quick stats:**
- 44 members, ~4,000 cards donated this week
- Clan War Trophies: 340
- Top trophy: 13,560 (Vijay)
- Multiple members above 12,000 trophies

**Who we are:**

POAP KINGS was founded by three people who wanted to build something worth staying in. We run active Clan Wars, track participation, and recognize real effort. We have a Free Pass Royale program — the top war contributor each season earns one. We issue POAPs for seasons and milestones, which creates a collectible record of clan history that most clans do not have. We also run Elixir, a clan AI that tracks wars, milestones, and donations so nothing gets lost.

**Standout members:**
- **Vijay** — 13,560 trophies, consistent Elder, one of our top war contributors
- **Chanco** — donation leader this week with 488 cards, a reliable clan backbone

**What we are looking for:**
- 3,000+ trophies to join
- Active players who show up for wars when they can
- Donators who support their clanmates
- Low drama, high effort

Real life comes first here. We do not guilt-trip. We just want people who care when they are around.

More info at **https://poapkings.com** — no invite link per subreddit rules, but come find us by tag or through the site.
